integrity: Complete elementary argument with independent exact Apéry enumeration and coin-change dynamic-program verification on stated finite ranges; no finite computation substitutes for the quantified proof.
scientific_limitations: Only three consecutive triangular generators; all starts and long-block spectrum, not a full shorter-block length histogram. The Apéry rectangle is prior literature; potential implicit coverage by general deserts work remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact gap-block starts and the sharp long-desert spectrum for consecutive triangular generators
